question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**design**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how Santosh Bisen spent his own money to create something new, specifically focusing on textbooks.
 
• The appropriate verb should suggest the creation or formulation of textbooks from scratch.
 
• **"Design"** fits well as it denotes the act of creating or planning something, which aligns with the context of making new textbooks.
 
• Other options ('**restore**', '**allocate**', '**mend**') do not convey the creation of new textbooks.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Santosh Bisen, science teacher and cartoonist at Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya in Durg, Chhattisgarh used__ his drawing **__skills__ to convert chapters into comic strips. "Convincing authorities to turn textbooks into comics was difficult. I spent my own money to **__design__** textbooks. I also used cartoons in question papers," he says. "Students were (4)________ with how simple science became and their performance (5)_________," he adds.** *

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Restore **(पुनःस्थापित करना): "Restore" means to bring back or reestablish, which does not fit as it implies returning something to a former condition, not creating new textbooks.
 
• **Allocate **(आवंटित करना): "Allocate" means to distribute or assign resources, which does not convey the act of creating or making textbooks.
 
• **Mend **(सुधारना): "Mend" means to repair or fix something that is broken, which does not imply the creation of new textbooks.
